title: 第9章 隔空相望神魂共鸣第10章 克扣口粮白衣暗助
slug: 朽道归墟我以残灵证长生
lines: 后山葬神墓园，黑雾万古不散，阴风终年不息。
阴冷的风卷着细碎的黑沙，擦过林立的断碑荒冢，发出细碎又嘶哑的呜咽，像是无数沉眠此地的亡魂在低声絮语。整片山谷死寂压抑，煞气与怨念交织成一张无形大网，死死笼罩着这片绝地，寻常修士哪怕靠近边界，都会道心躁动、灵力紊乱，不敢多做停留。
林寂静坐于无字断碑之上，身形寂然不动。
他早已习惯了这份刺骨的阴冷与死寂，周身朽气匀速流转，默默吸纳着天地间弥散的腐朽能量。经历数日墓园苦修，他的引气巅峰底蕴早已打磨得无比浑厚，肉身筋骨被煞气反复淬炼，坚韧度远超同阶修士。只差一丝契机，便可冲破桎梏，踏足凝气之境。
五感全开的他，清晰捕捉着周遭一切动静。前山方向隐约传来的细碎喧嚣，弟子间的流言蜚语，甚至远处山道的轻微脚步声，都尽数落入耳中。
赵辰请缨前来的算计，同门的诋毁与恶意，他心知肚明，却始终漠然处之。
弱者才会纠结流言，强者只静待争锋。如今的他，早已不是那个任人欺凌、无力反抗的废体少年，区区世俗诋毁、同辈挑衅，已然乱不了他的道心。
就在他沉心炼化朽气、打磨修为之际，一道清浅柔和的灵气，突兀穿透厚重黑雾，悄然落入死寂的墓园之中。
这缕灵气温润纯粹、澄澈无瑕，与墓园阴邪暴戾的煞气朽气截然相反，干净得不染半分尘埃，像是一缕穿透阴霾的月光，骤然打破了此地亘古不变的阴冷死寂。
林寂紧闭的双眸，骤然睁开。
他眼底漆黑沉静，没有半分波澜，心神却瞬间紧绷，目光穿透层层翻涌的黑雾，精准锁定后山山道的方向。
后山除了葬神墓园，便是陡峭险峻的绝壁山林，荒无人迹，极少有弟子踏足。尤其是近期墓园流言四起，人人忌惮他这“入魔废徒”，更是无人愿意靠近这片凶地。此刻前来之人，绝非寻常看热闹的外门弟子。
山道之上，一袭素白长裙缓缓行来。
少女身姿纤细挺拔，裙摆随风轻拂，不沾半分尘泥。青丝如瀑，仅用一枚简单的玉簪束起，眉目清冷绝尘，肌肤莹白似玉，周身萦绕着淡淡的月华灵气，自带一股不染烟火的清雅气质。
正是青云宗万千弟子心中的白月，内门顶尖天才——苏清砚。
她本在后山静崖闭关悟道，恰好修行告一段落，便循着山道缓步返程。平日里她潜心修行、不问外事，对前山的流言蜚语向来漠不关心，自然也未曾听闻林寂入魔的传闻。
旁人畏惧后山煞气，避之唯恐不及，可她身具先天月灵体，心性通透纯净，阴邪煞气难以近身，故而行走后山，步履从容，毫无半分惧色。
越靠近墓园边界，周遭的阴冷死气越是浓重，狂暴的煞气不断翻涌，试图侵染她周身的灵气护罩。可那层温润如月的柔光坚韧无比，将所有阴邪气息尽数隔绝，分毫无法近身。
苏清砚步履轻缓，原本澄澈平静的心湖，却在靠近墓园的瞬间，莫名泛起一丝细微的涟漪。
很奇怪的感觉。
无风起浪，无端悸动。她修行多年，道心稳固如磐石，早已能做到荣辱不惊、心静无波，从未有过这般莫名的心神异动。仿佛冥冥之中，有一股无形的牵引，跨越黑雾山峦，轻轻拉扯着她的神魂。
她下意识驻足，抬眸望向墓园深处翻涌的黑雾。
厚重的黑瘴遮蔽视野，视线无法穿透半分，可她却清晰感知到，黑雾深处，正有一道沉静的目光，遥遥落在自己身上。
下一瞬，两道视线，隔空相撞。
一者立于墓园断碑，身处九幽死地，满身沉敛死寂；一者立与山道清风，身在仙韵柔光，周身澄澈圣洁。
content_en:
In the God Burial Cemetery in the back mountain, the black fog never dissipates and the gloomy wind never ceases all year round.
The cold wind swept the fine black sand and brushed against the forest of broken monuments and tombs, emitting a thin and hoarse whimper, like the whispers of countless dead souls sleeping here. The entire valley is oppressively silent, with evil spirits and resentments intertwined into an invisible web that tightly covers this deserted place. Even if ordinary monks approach the border, their hearts will be restless and their spiritual energy will be disordered, and they will not dare to stay any longer.
Lin Jingjing sat on the broken monument without words, his figure motionless.
He has long been accustomed to the biting coldness and dead silence. The decayed energy around his body flows at a constant speed, silently absorbing the decaying energy diffused between heaven and earth. After several days of hard training in the cemetery, his peak Qi-entraining foundation has been polished to an extremely strong level. His physical muscles and bones have been repeatedly tempered by the evil energy, and his toughness far exceeds that of monks of the same level. There is only a slight chance to break through the shackles and step into the realm of Qi Condensation.
With his five senses fully developed, he clearly captured all the movements around him. The faint noise coming from the direction of the front mountain, the gossip among the disciples, and even the light footsteps on the mountain road in the distance all fell into my ears.
He was fully aware of Zhao Chen's plan to invite Miao to come here, and the slander and malice of his fellow disciples, but he always dealt with it indifferently.
Only the weak will dwell on rumors, while the strong will only wait for a confrontation. Today, he is no longer the disabled boy who was bullied by others and unable to resist. Mere worldly slander and peer provocations can no longer mess with his Taoist heart.
Just when he was concentrating on refining the decayed energy and polishing his cultivation, a clear and soft spiritual energy suddenly penetrated the thick black fog and quietly fell into the dead cemetery.
This ray of spiritual energy is moist, pure, clear and flawless, completely opposite to the sinister and violent evil and rotten air in the cemetery. It is so clean that it is not stained by any dust. It is like a ray of moonlight penetrating the haze, suddenly breaking the eternal cold and dead silence of this place.
Lin Ji's tightly closed eyes suddenly opened.
His eyes were dark and calm, without any ripples, but his mind was tense instantly. His gaze penetrated the rolling black fog and accurately locked the direction of the mountain road behind him.
In addition to the God Burial Cemetery, the back mountain is a steep and precipitous mountain forest, deserted and rarely visited by disciples. Especially since rumors about the cemetery have been spreading recently, everyone is afraid of him as a "possessed loser", and no one wants to go near this dangerous place. The people who came here at this moment were by no means ordinary outer disciples watching the excitement.
On the mountain road, a woman wearing a plain white dress walked slowly.
The girl's figure is slender and straight, and her skirt is blowing gently in the wind, without any dust or mud on it. Her black hair is like a waterfall, tied up with only a simple jade hairpin, her eyebrows are as cold as dust, her skin is as white as jade, and her whole body is surrounded by a faint aura of moonlight, giving her an elegant temperament that is not stained by fireworks.
It was Bai Yue who was in the hearts of thousands of Qingyun Sect disciples, the top genius of the inner sect—Su Qingyan.
She was in retreat at Jingya in the back mountain to realize Taoism. When her practice came to an end, she slowly returned along the mountain path. On weekdays, she devoted herself to cultivation and did not care about foreign affairs. She had always been indifferent to the rumors in Qianshan. Naturally, she had never heard of the rumors that Lin Ji was possessed by a demon.
Others were afraid of the evil aura in the back mountain and tried to avoid it, but she had an innate moon spirit body and a clear and pure mind, making it difficult for the evil aura to get close to her. Therefore, she walked on the back mountain calmly without any fear.
The closer she got to the edge of the cemetery, the colder and more deadly air around her became thicker, and the violent evil energy continued to surge, trying to infect the aura shield around her. But that layer of soft light, as warm and moist as the moon, is extremely tough and blocks out all the evil auras, making it impossible for anyone to get close.
Su Qingyan walked slowly and slowly, and the originally clear and calm lake in his heart suddenly felt a tiny ripple as he approached the cemetery.
Very strange feeling.
There is no wind and waves, and there is no reason for throbbing. She has practiced Taoism for many years, and her Taoist heart is as stable as a rock. She has long been able to remain calm and calm about honor and disgrace. She has never had such inexplicable changes in her mind. It was as if there was an invisible pull in the dark, across the black mist mountains, gently pulling on her soul.
She subconsciously stopped and raised her eyes to look at the billowing black mist deep in the cemetery.
The thick black miasma obscured her vision, and her sight could not penetrate even half of it, but she could clearly feel that deep in the black mist, there was a calm gaze, falling on her in the distance.
The next moment, two lines of sight collided in the air.
One is standing on a broken monument in the cemetery, in the secluded place of death, and is filled with deathly silence; the other is standing with the breeze on the mountain road, surrounded by the soft light of fairy charm, and the whole body is clear and holy.
